controlLaw: New engineering rate controller. Not the original Luminary099 P66 execution.

sources.title: Apollo 11 Mission Report, printed 5-2 and 5-5
sources.supports: P66 manual attitude, computer throttle and 1 ft/s rate command increments; pitch zero corresponds to vertical LM X axis.
sources.titleZh: Apollo 11 Mission Report（阿波罗11号任务报告）· 第5-2、5-5页
sources.supportsZh: P66由乘员控制姿态、计算机控制节流，下降率开关每次改变1英尺/秒。俯仰0°对应飞船X轴竖直。

sources.title: Apollo 11 Press Kit, PDF107 and110
sources.supports: LM-5 rated descent thrust 9870 lbf and throttle range 1050–6300 lbf. Full-thrust regime is outside this terminal model.
sources.titleZh: Apollo 11 Press Kit（阿波罗11号新闻资料）· PDF第107、110页
sources.supportsZh: LM-5下降发动机额定推力9870磅力，节流范围1050至6300磅力。本模型用于末段下降。

sources.title: Apollo 11 landing transcript, 102:43:26
sources.supports: Reported 400 ft altitude, 9 ft/s down and 58 ft/s forward. These anchor the starting state; they do not establish a complete flight-state snapshot.
sources.titleZh: Apollo 11 landing transcript（阿波罗11号着陆通话记录）· 102:43:26
sources.supportsZh: 初始读数采用通话中的高度400英尺、下降9英尺/秒和前向58英尺/秒。完整任务状态仍需核对。

sources.title: NASA Moon gravity
sources.titleZh: NASA Moon gravity（NASA月球重力资料）
sources.supportsZh: 采用近似月面重力加速度1.62米/秒²。

sources.title: NASA LM controls and displays diagram
sources.supports: Independent functional layout reference; exact LM-5 revision applicability remains unverified.
sources.titleZh: NASA LM controls and displays（NASA登月舱控制与显示图）
sources.supportsZh: 用于功能位置对照。原图修订版对LM-5的适用性尚未完成核验。

engineeringAssumptions.terrain: Deterministic schematic terrain, not survey data or reconstructed Tranquility Base.
engineeringAssumptions.window: Illustrative triangular commander window and angular scale; measured eye-point and pane geometry not registered.
engineeringAssumptions.touchdown: Reports impact speeds and attitude. No structural-damage or certified landing-safety classification.

visibleCockpit: NASSP original panel assets. Source-controlled image regions and DSKY transplant. Engineering model remains independent.
